nodes.natural_language: What is the greatest common factor of $20 !$ and $200,\!000$?  (Reminder: If $n$ is a positive integer, then $n!$ stands for the product $1\cdot 2\cdot 3\cdot \cdots \cdot (n-1)\cdot n$.) Show that it is 40,\!000.
